text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's Nakayama Festa! Nakayama
Festa
finishes in first!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hah... Ugh... Damn it...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: She's so... strong.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You look pretty worn out.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Obviously! I was trying to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This was only... my second time in a
graded race...
Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Don't start crying.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm not crying!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you! I'm gonna get mad
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not getting left in the dust by
someone in the
same year as me! I'm
gonna live my life as a super
strong
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You live your life.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Keep on living.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Today's G3 was more exciting than
usual.
Wait a second... Was that just who
I think it was?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You saw her too?! I knew my eyes
weren't playing
tricks on me. That had to
be—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's time to fly! Mambo!

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: Scrawww!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flap, flap!

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text:
Like a bird resting its wings on a branch
will
eventually soar high in the sky...

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you will reach your lofty goals as
well.

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text:
And then, with the setting sun at your
back, you'll
leap effortlessly over the
boundary between
today and tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text:
Fly among the twinkling stars, and
welcome the
bright morning with your
wings.

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text:
It will be so beautiful that I'll have
trouble looking
away.

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I want to live, inspired by your flight,
wishing I
could soar like you do.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure you still have a bunch more to
say, but
why don't you give the pen a
rest?

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
She should be here anytime soon, don't
you
think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text: See?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: How're you feeling, Teach?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Because of you, I decided to take my
chances
with the surgery."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"The success rate was depressingly low,
but I had
hope that I would be watching
you race again."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I had hope that I would overcome this
and live."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Teach. So... after the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...I had the surgery.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
It was a miracle. They kept
recommending her to
go on palliative
care, but she remained resilient.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't give up, which means... you
got what
you wanted.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry it's taken so long... to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her voice may be frail, but you can hear
her
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's okay, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Yes... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Let's take a step outside, Trainer. Just
for five
minutes. I'll buy you a drink.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
Would you prefer something hot or
cold?

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
I insist. It's the very least I can do to
show my
appreciation.
choice_data_list: Oh, please don't worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
You and Festa brought my daughter
confidence
time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's how this miracle came about. I
hold no
doubt about that. But...

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
It isn't over. Anything can still happen to
her,
even now...

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
The immediate danger has passed for
now, but
there's no saying she won't
relapse.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
She's very perceptive. I'm sure she'll
realize it
soon enough.
choice_data_list: Don't bring that up around Nakayama—

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
But whatever happens to my daughter, I
don't
want either of you to feel guilty.

text_block_list.name: Teach's Father
text_block_list.text:
I want you to be happy for the hope that
she feels
right now... Thank you for
everything.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And I saw the Chunichi Shimbun Hai... It
gave me
the power to stubbornly push
through.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Can you believe it? It's a been
year. A
whole year, and I'm still here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... "Stubbornly push through"? Heh.
That's
definitely something you would
say.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I'm serious... I'm even planning to go to
Paris to
cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then this time, there's no gamble. Let's
make it a
promise.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll go to Paris and... I'll even run in your
favorite
here too. The Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I guess that will be a little while
after the
violets bloom.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. So make sure you're watching.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll be getting first place at the
Takarazuka Kinen.
